model_note: Drag-free fit misses the measured path by 3.1 px RMS; predicting the second half from the first half misses by 10.8 px RMS. The bag slows horizontally in the image (4% of its vertical acceleration). Drag and the bag moving away from the camera both cause this; one camera cannot separate them.
